original_bug_description: A global-buffer-overflow exists in htmlParseHTMLAttribute (HTMLparser.c): the parser performs an out‑of‑bounds read (one byte) past a global string/array into adjacent global data (e.g. xmlIsPubidChar_tab) while parsing attribute text. This out‑of‑bounds access can cause crashes, undefined behavior, or potential information disclosure when processing crafted HTML attributes.
normalized_bug_description: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5788673912995840: libxml2 has a reported memory-safety bug. A global-buffer-overflow exists in htmlParseHTMLAttribute (HTMLparser.c): the parser performs an out‑of‑bounds read (one byte) past a global string/array into adjacent global data (e.g. xmlIsPubidChar_tab) while parsing attribute text. This out‑of‑bounds access can cause crashes, undefined behavior, or potential information disclosure when processing crafted HTML attributes.
